name: lanius-voice
description: How lanius talks — the plain-language rules for ALL user-facing copy in the product: UI strings, labels, buttons, empty states, errors, help text, and the helper/assistant's on-screen words. Use this whenever you write or edit text a person reads on screen (anything in ui/web/, or copy in a handler/skill that surfaces to a user). The one job: say less, plainly — name things as they are, cut words, and keep the invented vocabulary out. Full audit + before→after in docs/handoffs/web-ui-copy.md.
